references.title: DWDS: Langeweile
references.supports: The Wortzerlegung 1lang Weile; the Grammatik note: the occasional inflection of the adjectival first part recalls that the compound grew out of a phrase (vor, aus langer Weile); Genitiv Singular: Langeweile

notes.rationale: DWDS splits it lang + Weile. Lange shows the adjective with its frozen attributive ending, which the shown letters tolerate (ADR 0050; the user, 2026-10-25, #1241), so the e is no Interfix. Held out of every Breakdown prompt's examples (#693).
